description:
Read a file already uploaded to a file session: its finished size, page count and orientation. Returns facts in a few seconds, not a reading of the file's content (no text, colors or design classification).

The finished size is the file's trim box when it has one. Without one, a page that is a standard product size plus standard bleed (0.125 in a side) is read as that size with bleed; otherwise the page is the size. recommendedSelections carries that finished size (left out when it can't be told), ready to compare with a configuration. Works on PDF, PNG and JPEG (an image needs a resolution to have a size). Pass the result, or just the fileSessionId, to recommend_products to find products that print this size.

fileName.description: Which file to read. Optional when the session has exactly one file.

fileSessionId.description: File session ID holding the uploaded file.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for a just-uploaded PDF to be read before falling back to its page sizes (default 10; at most 30 is used).

name: analyze_file
